text:
incident-bot: PAGER: Elevated 5xx rate detected for dedicated-cluster brightbank-prod (cluster: dbk-prod-eu). 5xx rate: 22% over 5m, spike started ~07:10 PDT. Paging primary on-call @sara :rotating_light:

sara: On it. Going to spin up thread. Can someone pull recent router and pool metrics?

matt: grabbing metrics... looks like GPU utilization is pegged on pool-gpu-12..14. queue_length spiked to 480. `nvidia-smi` shows memory 100% on pods pg-2345/pg-2346.

deepa: runtime logs show a ton of `gateway upstream read timeout` and `model_container OOM` for model-id redwood-7b-quant. snippet:
```
ERROR gateway: upstream error: read timeout
WARN runtime/model: OOM while allocating KV cache for seq_len=8192 tenant=brightbank
```

lucas: hypothesis: noisy tenant saturating KV cache and causing evictions -> heavier tails -> gateways timing out. Which tenant? any spikes in tenant-ids?

matt: querying tenant metrics... tenant `ad-network-88` has a huge burst of long sequences and batch infer jobs. It has 70% of requests in last 10m and long tail 2s median -> causing backpressure.

sara: immediate mitigations: 1) enable per-tenant rate limit for ad-network-88 to 20 rps; 2) route brightbank to fallback pool (region-us-west-2) for the next 30m; 3) scale up dedicated pool by +2 nodes. Applying now.

sara: `rbac@ops` running `traffic-router update --tenant brightbank --route region-us-west-2 --timeout 180s` and `dedicated scale --pool brightbank-prod --add 2` :white_check_mark:

deepa: also set `runtime.circuit_breaker.enabled=true` for model redwood-7b-quant on that pool to fail fast on OOM and trigger fallback model variant.

matt: executed tenant throttle: `tenants throttle --id ad-network-88 --limit 20` — confirmed in metrics, incoming rate dropped to ~18 rps.

incident-bot: ACTIONS LOGGED: route change, pool scale, tenant throttle. Incident channel: #incidents/1912345000

sara: Customer impact: BrightBank reported 60% elevated 5xx for user-facing inference calls. SRE timeline:
- 07:10 PDT: alerts
- 07:16 PDT: tenant throttle applied
- 07:20 PDT: route to fallback region started
- 07:28 PDT: pool scale completed

deepa: post-mitigation logs show 5xx dropped to ~3% and queue length back to normal ~40. gateway timeouts decreased.

lucas: root cause summary: noisy tenant `ad-network-88` launched a large batch export with long sequences, caused KV cache thrashing and model OOMs on shared dedicated pool for BrightBank. The scheduler did not preempt quickly enough; eviction latencies allowed saturation.

sara: next steps: 1) migrate ad-network-88 to isolated tenant pool; 2) add preemption policy for long-seq batch jobs on shared pools; 3) follow up with BrightBank CS to confirm mitigation and SLA credit if needed.

eng-lead: please create postmortem and add measurement dashboards (per-tenant sequence length, KV eviction rate). Assign to Deepa and Lucas.

sara: handing overnight to matt for monitoring until 11:00 PDT. Handoff notes: mitigations applied, watch for re-burst from ad-network-88, keep scaling on standby. Full logs and commands in incident doc.

matt: ack. I'll monitor and escalate if necessary. ping me @here for any new 5xx >10%.

incident-bot: This incident thread will be updated with severity and postmortem link. :spiral_notepad:
